function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Contact | |---------|---------|------------|---------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** – the main rail hub for Metrorail and Tri‑Rail | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | • Pets are allowed on **Metrorail** and **Tri‑Rail** trains, but must be in a carrier or on a leash.
• The station itself is pet‑friendly: there are no restrictions on pets in the concourse, and the station has a dedicated “pet relief” area near the entrance.
• Pets must be leashed or in a carrier at all times while on the platform and in the station. | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [miami.gov/miami-intermodal-center](https://www.miami.gov/miami-intermodal-center) | ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet | Tip | Why It Helps | |-----|--------------| | **Use a carrier or leash** | Keeps your pet safe and compliant with train rules. | | **Bring a waste bag** | Keeps the station clean and shows respect for other passengers. | | **Pack a water bowl & treats** | Keeps your pet hydrated and happy during the ride. | | **Check the train’s pet policy** | Some trains allow only small pets; double‑check before you board. | | **Call ahead** | If you have a special request (e.g., a large dog or medical needs), the station staff can help you plan. | **Where to Find More Info** - **Metrorail Pet Policy**: [Metrorail – Pets](https://www.metromiami.com/plan-your-trip/pets/) - **Tri‑Rail Pet Policy**: [Tri‑Rail – Pets](https://www.tri-rail.com/plan-your-trip/pets/) Feel free to call the station or visit the website for the most up‑to‑date information before you travel. Enjoy your trip with your furry friend!
